name: Borys Budka - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the renewal of the Agreement for scientific and technological cooperation between the European Community and the Government of the Republic of India
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that the European Union should renew its science and technology cooperation agreement with India for another five years. The deal stays the same as the current one. It creates no new rights or obligations. It keeps joint work going in areas like clean energy, health, artificial intelligence and sustainable development, and it keeps researcher exchanges and market access for European companies. Parliament's role here is simply to give its consent, which it has done.

- The existing science and technology agreement with India is extended for five years, unchanged.
- It affects researchers, universities and companies in the European Union and India.
- The Council can now formally adopt the renewal, so cooperation continues.
